description: This file defines a PHPStan rule class 'UnsafeStrictGroupsCallRule' that analyzes static calls to certain regex matching methods to determine if they are potentially unsafe due to ambiguous or nullable match groups.

classes.name: UnsafeStrictGroupsCallRule
classes.description: A PHPStan rule class that checks static regex method calls for potential safety issues related to match groups.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Returns the type of PHP parser node this rule processes, which is StaticCall.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Analyzes a static call node to determine if it involves regex match methods and if the match groups are potentially unsafe due to nullability or ambiguity.
